subject: How to reverse y axis levels?

messages.author: 2401d0740178cf07
messages.subject: How to reverse y axis levels?
parts:
Dear all,

I'm trying to plot humidity in 11 soil levels as a "heatmap". I managed to accomplish this, but my y-axis are in the wrong order. I need to show the top layer at the top ot the graphic, mimicking a cross section of the soil.

Please run this code to reproduce the plot:

---------------------------------------------------------------------
require (RCurl)
require (ggplot2)
require (reshape)
require (scales)

# read data
link <- getURL('http://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/27700634/zday_soil-zwsoi.eq.1.txt')
dry.soil <- read.csv(textConnection(link), header=T, sep='')

# get date from character
tmp1 <- paste(dry.soil$year, dry.soil$month, dry.soil$day, sep='/')
date <- as.Date(tmp1)

# add date amd remove old elements
dry.soil <- cbind(date, dry.soil)

dry.soil <- subset(dry.soil, select = -c(year,month,day,jday))

# constraint date
dry.soil <- subset(dry.soil, as.Date(date) >= '2012-01-01' & as.Date(date) <= '2012-12-31') 

# create month factor to produce average
dry.soil$monfac <- droplevels(cut(dry.soil$date, breaks='month'))

# 
dry.df <- aggregate(cbind(soil_mois1, soil_mois2, soil_mois3, 
                          soil_mois4, soil_mois5, soil_mois6, 
                          soil_mois7, soil_mois8, soil_mois9, 
                          soil_mois10, soil_mois11) ~ monfac, data=dry.soil, FUN='mean', na.action=na.pass)

# melt data.frame by date
dry.soil.m <- melt(dry.df, id = c('monfac'))
dry.soil.m$monfac <- as.Date(dry.soil.m$monfac)

# plot data
ggplot(dry.soil.m, aes(monfac, variable)) +
geom_tile(aes(fill = value), colour = "white") + 
scale_fill_gradient(low = "white",  high = "steelblue") +
scale_x_date(breaks = date_breaks("months"),
             labels = date_format("%b"))
---------------------------------------------------------------------

As you can see, the y-axis is ordered from soil_mois1 to soil_mois11, but I need to reverse it so the top layer is at the top of the graphic.

Any directions?

Thanks in advance,
Thiago Veloso.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: How to reverse y axis levels?
parts:
?scale_y_reverse or see
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/scale_continuous.html
where there is an example about fifth or sixth from the bottom from a
quick scan of the page.

Dennis
